acceptance: The program name the subprocess bound manages is one named constant in acsassert, used at assertions.go:156, subprocess_bound.go:49 and subprocess_bound.go:60.
fix: Name the go tool once (for example const goTool = "go") and use it at the three sites.
summary: The ACS subprocess bound manages the Go test timeout of the go tool, but the program name "go" is a bare literal in three places of acsassert. A change to one site leaves the others inconsistent.
title: acsassert names the go tool once
